card.name: "with" before recent MI in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The word "with" (or "of") in NSAID cardiovascular warnings, right before "a recent MI" or "myocardial infarction". It is strongest in "If [drug] is used in patients with a recent MI".

modes.label: Patients with recent MI
modes.description: "with" after "used in patients" in the NSAID recent-heart-attack warning sentence.
modes.example: If COMBOGESIC IV is used in patients<< with>> a recent MI, monitor patients for signs

modes.label: Increased incidence of MI
modes.description: "of" after "increased incidence" before myocardial infarction and stroke in the CABG trial sentence.
modes.example: increased incidence<< of>> myocardial infarction and stroke.

card.plain: It marks the little word just before "recent MI" in the standard NSAID heart-risk warning.
evidence: If flurbiprofen is used in patients<< with>> a recent MI, monitor patients for signs
